title: Skill frontmatter schema compatibility
limitations: Static parsing cannot prove the current Agent received the Skill.

title: Skill UTF-8 BOM detection
limitations: A clean encoding check does not prove TRAE runtime loading.

title: Skill YAML special-character safety
limitations: Parser behavior may differ by TRAE release.

title: Skill multi-source and version conflict
limitations: Inventory overlap is not proof of the final Agent priority.

title: MCP command path with spaces
limitations: A safe preview must not execute an untrusted command.

title: MCP executable and PATH resolution
limitations: A candidate executable is not proof that TRAE can start the Server.

title: MCP tool count and description budget
limitations: The reported limits may be version-specific and require runtime probing.

title: MCP server and tool name length
limitations: The threshold must be learned from the target TRAE runtime, not guessed globally.

title: MCP configured but Agent did not call
limitations: No tool-call cannot by itself distinguish routing, model choice, policy, or user prompt causes.

title: Global Rule reload and behavior evidence
limitations: Logs may prove discovery but not model compliance; behavior acceptance is required.
